subject: Pilot: request for safety-net credits due to integration throttle
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@testcorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: request for safety-net credits due to integration throttle

Hi Sarah —

Quick note from our side after reviewing the logs your team shared this morning. It looks like TestCorp's webhook rate limit is intermittently throttling the connector during peak test runs; that’s what’s stalling the POC runbook and preventing the demo workload from completing.

We want to keep momentum on the pilot — the customer engineering team is actively implementing a backoff/fanout fix but they estimate ~2 weeks to fully stabilize. To avoid the POC being cut short while they do that, can we provision a short safety-net: 2,000 trial credits and a 30‑day trial extension? The ask is one-time promotional credits so the team can continue validating the flow while the infra fix lands.

If that works for you I’ll loop in Sales Ops for approval and pass along a minimal mutual action plan (timeline + acceptance criteria) so everyone’s aligned.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — East
Redwood Inference

Attachments: integration_logs.zip (see sample throttle traces)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@testcorp.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Huang <tom.huang@testcorp.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 10:01:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: request for safety-net credits due to integration throttle

Markus —

Thanks for flagging. Confirmed — our infra team can see the spikes and the planned fix is to add a short-lived queue + exponential backoff; estimate 10 business days to roll and validate. We appreciate the offer of credits — that would help us keep the pilot live while we push the change.

A couple asks from our side:
- Can you send the exact extension/end date you’d propose?
- We will need a one-page acknowledgement from Redwood confirming the credit grant and that it’s a one-time promotional credit (for our procurement group).

I’m copying Tom (eng lead) so he can comment on timeline and validate acceptance tests.

— Sarah
Director, Solutions Engineering
TestCorp

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 08:37:45 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot: request for safety-net credits due to integration throttle — approval request

Team — forwarding the thread with TestCorp. They’re asking for: 2,000 trial credits + a 30‑day extension while their infra team performs a backoff/queue rollout.

Rationale: this is mid-stage pilot (DEAL-4521) with clear engineering root cause on their side; the credits are time-limited and intended to preserve the POC cadence so we can reach the demo acceptance criteria. I’ve attached the highlighted logs they sent (integration_logs.zip).

Recommendation (low-risk):
- One-time promotional credits: 2,000 token credits
- Extend trial end date by 30 days from current contract window
- Provide a 1‑page credit acknowledgement for TestCorp procurement

Estimated cost to Redwood (conservative): ~$1,200 in variable unit economics for the duration.

Approval requested by EOD today so we can communicate to customer and prevent an abort.

Thanks,
Monica
Pilot Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: integration_logs.zip (same as above)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:14:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: request for safety-net credits due to integration throttle — approval request

Thanks Monica — I’m good to approve the one-time promo. Sign-off below:

- Grant 2,000 promotional credits to TestCorp (DEAL-4521)
- Extend trial end date by 30 calendar days from their current expiry
- Ops to generate a 1-page acknowledgement PDF for procurement (see attached MOP form stub)

I’ve attached the MOP_approval_form.pdf for record-keeping. Monica, Ben — please update HubSpot and send the acknowledgement to Sarah + Tom.

Aditya Rao
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MOP_approval_form.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@testcorp.com>
Cc: Tom Huang <tom.huang@testcorp.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: request for safety-net credits due to integration throttle

Sarah/Tom — thanks for the quick responses and for the engineering ETA.

We’ve approved a one-time safety-net of 2,000 promotional credits and extended your trial window by 30 days (new expiry: 2027-07-17). You’ll receive a short acknowledgement PDF from Sales Ops (Aditya copied) within the hour; that doc will state the credits are promotional and one-time.

Next steps:
- Aditya/Monica: please share the acknowledgement to sarah.lee@testcorp.com and tom.huang@testcorp.com and attach the administrative MOP.
- Tom: once your backoff/queue rollout is validated, please reply here with the date so we can mark acceptance complete on our end.

Appreciate the collaboration — we’ll keep monitoring the pilot metrics on our side.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — East
Redwood Inference

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4521
Attachments: MOP_approval_form.pdf (Sales Ops will send formal acknowledgement)
